home.desc: Bitchat integrates decentralized messaging, AI research bots, and automated copy trading. Wallet as identity, chat as trading — one App for all Web3 scenarios.
pain.title: Four Pain Points
pain.subtitle: of Web3 Users
pain.solve: We solve them one by one
pain.1d: Chat on Discord, check prices on CoinGecko, trade on exchanges — switching between 5+ apps daily
pain.2d: Centralized platforms control your data and social graph, can ban, censor, or leak at any time
pain.3d: On-chain data scattered everywhere, hard for average users to quickly access key insights
pain.4d: Delay between spotting an opportunity and executing a trade lets countless Alpha slip away
feat.title: Four Core Features
feat.subtitle: One App, All Web3 Scenarios
feat.1d: Wallet address as account, end-to-end encrypted messaging. Token-gated group chats — only holders of specific NFTs or tokens can join, creating exclusive spaces for every community.
feat.2d: Enter a token name, get a professional research report in 10 seconds. Aggregates CoinGecko, DefiLlama, on-chain data and more. Type /research ETH in chat to trigger.
feat.3d: Connect your exchange API, subscribe to TradingView signals, auto-execute trades. Your assets stay in your own account. Four layers of risk control, safe and transparent.
feat.4d: One-click connect MetaMask, WalletConnect and more. Wallet is identity, no registration or password needed. Supports NFT avatar display and on-chain identity verification.
phil.title: Design Philosophy
phil.subtitle: Three core values we believe in
phil.1d: Your wallet is your identity. No centralized registration, no phone binding, no one can freeze your account.
phil.2d: AI research gives everyone access to professional-grade market analysis, no longer a privilege of the few.
phil.3d: Complex blockchain technology should be hidden behind a clean interface. We aim to make Web3 as easy as Web2.

research.btcSummary: Bitcoin maintains its dominance as the leading digital store of value. Institutional adoption continues with ETF inflows exceeding $2B monthly. Halving cycle dynamics suggest continued upward pressure. Lightning Network adoption accelerating. Key resistance at $100K psychological level.
research.ethSummary: ETH fundamentals are strong with staking rate rising to 27.3%. L2 ecosystem (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base) is thriving. EIP-4844 significantly reduced L2 fees, driving on-chain activity to new highs. Institutional holdings steadily increasing. Recommend long-term hold, watch $4,000 resistance.
research.solSummary: SOL ecosystem continues to expand with steady DeFi TVL growth. Firedancer client launching soon will significantly boost network performance. NFT market activity recovering, Jupiter DEX leading in volume. Watch for network stability risks and FTX legacy token unlock pressure.
research.arbSummary: Arbitrum leads the L2 race with highest TVL and developer activity. Stylus upgrade enables Rust/C++ smart contracts. DAO governance active with significant treasury. Token unlock schedule creates medium-term sell pressure. Strong fundamentals for long-term L2 thesis.
research.linkSummary: Chainlink CCIP cross-chain protocol gaining rapid adoption. Oracle dominance unchallenged with 80%+ market share. Staking v0.2 expanding, reducing circulating supply. Key infrastructure for DeFi and RWA tokenization narratives. Strong institutional partnerships.
research.avaxSummary: Avalanche subnet architecture shows promise but ecosystem growth has slowed relative to competitors. Institutional partnerships (Spruce, Evergreen) provide differentiation. Gaming and RWA focus areas. Need to monitor developer retention and TVL trends closely.
research.renderSummary: RENDER benefits strongly from AI narrative momentum. GPU rendering network sees growing demand from AI/ML workloads. Migration to Solana improved performance. High beta play on AI infrastructure theme. Significant price volatility expected.
research.pepeSummary: PEPE shows classic meme token characteristics with extreme volatility and no fundamental utility. Whale concentration is high with top 100 wallets holding 45%+ supply. Community-driven momentum fading. High risk of significant drawdowns. Not suitable for risk-averse investors.

onboarding.welcomeDesc: The Web3-native social platform where your wallet is your identity. Chat securely, research with AI, and trade automatically.
onboarding.walletSubtitle: New to Web3? No worries. Here's everything you need to know.
onboarding.edu.identityDesc: A wallet is your unique digital identity on the blockchain. Like a passport for the internet, it proves who you are without revealing personal information.
onboarding.edu.keysDesc: Your private key is the master password. A seed phrase (12-24 words) is its backup. Write it down on paper and store it safely offline. Never share it with anyone.
onboarding.edu.blockchainDesc: Every transaction is recorded on a public ledger that no single entity controls. This means your assets are truly yours — no bank can freeze them, no company can delete them.
onboarding.edu.assetsDesc: Your wallet can hold cryptocurrencies (ETH, BTC), NFTs (digital art & collectibles), and tokens that give you voting power in DAOs. One wallet, infinite possibilities.
onboarding.faq.whatIsWalletA: A crypto wallet is like a digital bank account that only you control. It stores your private keys — the passwords that prove you own your digital assets.
onboarding.faq.isSafe: Is it safe? What if I lose my phone?
onboarding.faq.isSafeA: Your assets live on the blockchain, not on your phone. As long as you have your seed phrase backed up safely, you can recover your wallet on any device.
onboarding.faq.whatCanDo: What can I do with a wallet?
onboarding.faq.whatCanDoA: Send and receive crypto, interact with DeFi protocols, collect NFTs, vote in DAOs, sign in to Web3 apps — all without creating an account.
onboarding.goldenRuleDesc: NEVER share your seed phrase or private key with anyone — not even Bitchat. We will never ask for it.
onboarding.connectDesc: Your wallet address becomes your identity. No email, no phone number needed.
